data.name: MX0001Description
data.value: Default logging methods like LogInformation, LogWarning, LogError must not be used. Use LogStart, LogCheckPoint, or LogEnd instead.

data.name: MX0002Description
data.value: This rule ensures that 'LogStart' is used only once in a method to avoid redundant logging at the beginning of method execution. Multiple calls to 'LogStart' within the same method could indicate improper logging practices or unnecessary duplication.

data.name: MX0002MessageFormat
data.value: The 'LogStart' method should appear at most once in a method

data.name: MX0003Title
data.value: LogStart must be paired with LogEnd

data.name: MX0003Description
data.value: 'LogStart' must have exactly one 'LogEnd' call within the same method. Ensure that 'LogEnd' is called before any 'return' statements to maintain proper logging flow.

data.name: MX0003MessageFormat
data.value: 'LogStart' must be paired with a corresponding 'LogEnd'

data.name: MX0004Description
data.value: Ensures that LogStart is called before LogEnd in the same method.

data.name: MX0004MessageFormat
data.value: LogStart must be invoked before LogEnd
